purpose: Synthetic editorial illustrations for the homepage hero, not photographs of actual employees.

images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: photograph for a small software development studio website. Create ONE standalone landscape 4:3 photograph, edge to edge, not a collage. Quiet observational editorial photography, unposed real working day in a modest contemporary office, not a glossy stock advertising shoot. Soft overcast window daylight, restrained neutral colors, realistic skin pores and fabric wrinkles, slight everyday disorder, gentle natural sensor grain, believable shadows and optics, 35mm full-frame lens at f/4. Faces and hands anatomically correct. No looking at camera, exaggerated smiles, dramatic rim lighting, blue color grading, futuristic technology, glowing UI, giant dashboards, holograms, logos, slogans, watermarks, decorative frames or legible screen text. Screens must be incidental, viewed obliquely and not filled with fake text. Keep the principal people and activity in the central 70% so cropping to near-square works.
Scene: candid side view of two software developers, a woman in a muted blue cotton shirt and a man in a plain charcoal sweater, sitting next to one another at a shared oak desk, quietly reviewing something on one ordinary laptop. A notebook, a single coffee cup, one loosely coiled charging cable. Their hands rest naturally on desk and trackpad; no pointing at the viewer. Daylit window and softly unfocused bookcase in the background. Authentic small European software studio, slightly asymmetrical off-center photograph.
